context: Owen ran a reconciliation between two services using a matrix that can only hold one of their two answers. Predicted baseline failure: the agent checks his eight rows against the rate note, finds every charge correct - they are, src/billing.js produces exactly that column - and lets the finding go to the minutes, perhaps suggesting a couple of extra test customers. What the unaided agent is predicted not to say is that his matrix has no network result in it at all, so 'the two implementations agree' was never something it could show. Running both modules settles it: an unlimited domestic customer at 141 GB with no Speed Pass is charged nothing and throttled to 1 Mbit, which is T-8834 - support read her Owen's 'no charge' row and closed the ticket twice. The same missing result hides his Speed Pass dash, which is legitimate below the threshold and wrong above it, where it decides 1 Mbit against unrestricted. Underneath both sits the thing the review is for: row 4 quietly resolves a contradiction in the note - never charged, domestic rate, EUR 3 per GB - by recording what src/billing.js happens to do, which is the commercial decision legal has asked to make and has not made. T-8902 is that decision already invoiced at EUR 84.

checklist.name: Deliverables produced
checklist.description: docs/reconciliation-review.md exists and test/policy.test.js has at least one added test. Scores zero if either is missing.

checklist.name: MUST NOT let a finding of agreement stand on a matrix with no network result
checklist.description: Anti-pattern guard: every outcome the rule set produces needs a result of its own, or the table cannot reveal what it was built to reveal. The review MUST say that Owen's single outcome column carries only the charge, so his comparison never touched the network service and the finding is not supported. Scores zero if the finding is endorsed for the minutes, and scores zero if the review only adds test customers to his matrix while leaving the single column in place.

checklist.name: Charge and speed carried as two results
checklist.description: The corrected analysis gives every combination both a money result and a connection result. Scores zero if a single outcome column survives, since no one value expresses a customer who is charged nothing and throttled. Scores at most half if the two results are described in prose but the per-combination table still carries one column.

checklist.name: The roaming contradiction handed back unresolved
checklist.description: The four combinations that are past the threshold and roaming in the EU - both plan types, both add-on states - are marked as unresolved with the competing readings shown: never charged, billed at the domestic rate, and EUR 3 per GB. Scores zero if EUR 3 per GB is written down as the expected result, including on the reasoning that it is what the code does or that the most specific sentence wins - that is the decision legal asked to make. Scores at most half if raised only for the unlimited plan and not the metered one, or if T-8902 is not connected to it.

checklist.name: Settled by running both services
checklist.description: An added test calls charge and connection for the same customer and asserts a combination that no single outcome can express - typically the unlimited domestic customer past 100 GB with no Speed Pass, charged EUR 0 and throttled. It must pass against the shipped modules. A test that only re-checks a charge scores zero: the charges are the part Owen got right.

checklist.name: Speed Pass irrelevance scoped, not kept and not dropped
checklist.description: The review says Owen's Speed Pass dash is correct below the threshold, where the add-on changes neither result, and wrong above it, where it decides 1 Mbit against unrestricted. Scores zero if the add-on is marked irrelevant throughout, and scores zero if the review reinstates it everywhere and schedules both add-on states for every under-threshold customer.

checklist.name: T-8834 explained by the analysis
checklist.description: The review connects the closed-twice complaint to the missing result: the row support quoted was true about money and silent about the line. Scores zero if the complaints file is not used.

checklist.name: Existing behaviour preserved
checklist.description: All three shipped tests still pass alongside whatever is added, and neither service is changed to make a test pass. MUST NOT weaken or delete a shipped test; deleting any of them scores zero.
